C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  RECOMMENDATION TO ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. 017­2022 APPROVING THE ADOPTION
  OF A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (MOU) BETWEEN THE CITY OF HAWAIIAN
  GARDENS AND THE AMERICAN FEDERATION OF THE STATE, COUNTY, AND MUNICIPAL
  EMPLOYEES (AFSCME) LOCAL 36, RANK & FILE UNIT

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, presented the staff report.

  Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney, spoke.

  Councilmember Farfan spoke.

  Mayor Roa spoke.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Alvarado, seconded by Councilmember Gomez, to
  approve recommendation and adopt Resolution No. 017­2022 with the following three
  amendments: [1] In Section 3, Tiered Layoff recall Language ­ Additional Language: This language
  will apply moving forward to those hired after January 1, 2022 (People currently on the recall list or
  recently recalled will not be considered new hires); [2] In Section 5, COLA Pay out ­ Additional
  language: Three percent (3%) COLA retroactive to the first day of the first pay­period in Fiscal Year
  2020/2021 to the last day of the last pay period in Fiscal Year 2020/2021; continuing with the first
  day of the first pay period in Fiscal Year 2021/2022 until the new pay rates are in effect in the
  payroll system, which shall be no later than 4/30/2022 and the retro payable by no later than
  5/19/2022 for all hours worked and/or paid (not to include June/Dec cash out); and [3] In Section 6,
  Holidays: Full timers giving up Lincoln’s Birthday; Part timers get New Year’s Day.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)
